2609.11282.title: When Does Text Inform? Benchmarking Information-Theoretic Metrics for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
2609.11282.paper_summary: Multimodal forecasting models that combine time series with text annotations promise richer prediction through textual context, but how do we know whether a text annotation meaningfully contributes to the forecasters prediction? This is an information-theoretic question, but to evaluate whether information-theoretic metrics can reliably measure the predictive value an annotation provides, a ground truth benchmark is needed, and none currently exist. We create a synthetic time series signal with annotations in three categories: semantically correct, incorrect, and irrelevant. Because the data generation process is fully controlled, ground-truth information content is known exactly, enabling principled evaluation of six complementary mutual information estimators (KSG, MINE, InfoNCE, CCA, PID and V-information). We show that all six estimators identify correct annotations as most informative, and are able to audit the quality of mixed text corpora, choosing the annotations that result in the best downstream forecasting results without the need for model training. Our benchmark identifies limitations of each estimator, and these are validated on seven real-world datasets, which show how estimator performance differs on weak signals. Finally, we establish practical rules for implementing these metrics for annotation auditing and fusion selection.
2609.11282.paper_summary_zh: 多模態預測模型結合了時間序列與文本註釋，通過文本上下文提供更豐富的預測，但我們如何知道一個文本註釋是否對預測者的預測有實質性的貢獻？這是一個信息理論問題，但要評估信息理論指標是否能可靠地衡量註釋所提供的預測價值，需要一個基準真相，而目前並不存在這樣的基準。我們創建了一個合成的時間序列信號，並在三個類別中進行註釋：語義正確、不正確和無關。由於數據生成過程完全可控，基準真相的信息內容是完全已知的，這使得對六種互信息估計器（KSG、MINE、InfoNCE、CCA、PID 和 V-information）進行原則性評估成為可能。我們展示了所有六種估計器都能將正確的註釋識別為最具信息量的，並能夠審核混合文本語料庫的質量，選擇出能在不需要模型訓練的情況下產生最佳下游預測結果的註釋。我們的基準識別了每個估計器的局限性，並在七個真實世界數據集上進行了驗證，顯示了估計器在弱信號上性能的差異。最後，我們建立了實施這些指標以進行註釋審核和融合選擇的實用規則。
2609.11282.author: Emma Andrews et.al.
